scope: Six visitor-experience priorities following live desktop and mobile audit

changes.home: Five contemporary cover combinations, mobile search before photograph, compact equal-choice consent
changes.destinations: Two three-guide starting choices for each of Tokyo, Singapore, London, Paris, Porto and Gaia, Kyoto
changes.planner: One day at a time, explicit local complementary suggestions on request, direct access and location links, preserved notes and all-day export
changes.guide: Smaller title and photograph with practical actions earlier; current visitor category
changes.curation: Twelve hands-on beginner choices; historical membership ledger retained
changes.editorial: Three source-linked city articles and seven future discovery slots, historical published discoveries preserved

flows: share omits private notes by default
validation.analytics: No Google request before consent; grant and revoke checked; private search query excluded
validation.accessibility: No detected WCAG A/AA violations in sampled views
validation.images: All images loaded in sampled views

limits: Browser QA is not a user-research or retention measurement
Planning suggestions do not assert live availability, transfer time or combined bookings
deployment: Pending final public verification in release response
